effect_description_eng:
＜Scapegoat＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted other than by your effects, by deleting 1 of your other Digimon, prevent that deletion.)
[When Digivolving] You may play 1 purple level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted, you may play 1 purple level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost
